payload.text: The Heart of the Manor shudders! The Blackwood Matriarch dissipates into moth-dust as the sun breaks through the Attic windows. You survive, but the smell of lavender and rot will follow you forever.
Your name is added to the family tree. The house claims another soul. The shadows whisper their grim welcome...
You step further into the dusty Ground Floor. The peeling wallpaper seems to watch you...
A chill runs down your spine. The portraits' painted eyes track your movements...
The air grows colder still. You reach the final room of the Ground Floor.
You enter the Guest Wing. A sorrowful wail echoes. The Weeping Bride approaches...
The Weeping Bride is banished! You claim The Hand of Glory! Its cursed whispers now permanently haunt your mind.
Shadows warp around the abandoned guest beds. The floorboards creak with unseen weight.
A sudden clinking of dinner glasses turns into the sound of breaking bone.
The manor actively resists your presence! Doors open into rooms that shouldn't exist.
You breach the Hidden Lab. A Shadow Stalker awaits, carrying a rusted music box!
The Stalker crumbles to ash! You claim Anna Blackwood's Music Box. Its eerie melody seeps into your soul...
You climb the rusted iron stairs toward the Attic. The smell of sulfur chokes the air.
The core of the fever. Decaying medical tools rattle on their own.
You reach the upper sanctum! The Caretaker blocks the final door, a mass of pure malice!
The Caretaker falls! You claim The Obsidian Lens, but suffer its blurred visions. The Heart of the Manor opens! The Matriarch awaits!
You spend 2 Sanity to gather your scattered tools and refocus your mind.
You gather your tools, but the paralyzed Hand of Glory whispers dread! Lose 4 Sanity to clear your mind.
The whispers and the eerie melody of the Music Box claw at your sanity! Lose 6 Sanity.
Blurred visions shatter your mind! The crushing weight of all three curses forces you to lose 8 Sanity as you reload!
You strike with the Silver Dagger! The ghost retaliates.
HYSTERIA! Your panicked strike hits harder, but leaves you vulnerable!
Empowered by The Hand of Glory, your Dagger cuts deeper into the ectoplasm!
HYSTERIA! The Artifact fuels your wild, desperate strike!
Two cursed Artifacts hum with dark energy as you strike!
HYSTERIA! Unbound madness and dark power crush the specter!
Fully corrupted by the Obsidian Lens, your Dagger effortlessly rends the spirit!
HYSTERIA! The Matriarch's own power turns against her in your frenzied, terrifying assault!
You slash with the off-hand Dagger! The ghost retaliates.
HYSTERIA! Your panicked strike hits harder, but leaves you vulnerable!
Empowered by The Hand of Glory, your Dagger cuts deeper into the ectoplasm!
HYSTERIA! The Artifact fuels your wild, desperate strike!
Two cursed Artifacts hum with dark energy as you strike!
HYSTERIA! Unbound madness and dark power crush the specter!
Fully corrupted by the Obsidian Lens, your Dagger effortlessly rends the spirit!
HYSTERIA! The Matriarch's own power turns against her in your frenzied, terrifying assault!
A line of salt restores your sanity and weakens the ghost's grip!
HYSTERIA! The salt grounds you, but the ghost's counterattack cuts deeper through your madness!
A thin line of white guards you, restoring sanity and dropping the ghost's phasing!
HYSTERIA! You furiously pour the salt, but taking the hit still rattles your fragile mind!
Iron filings scatter like sand, abruptly dropping the ghost's phasing defenses! It lashes out.
HYSTERIA! You hurl the iron into the dark. The ghost screams and strikes you back harder!
The cold touch of earth's core burns the specter! Phasing significantly drops.
HYSTERIA! The shadows writhe as the iron burns them, drawing blood and sanity from you!
You burn sage, purging your mind of fear. A powerful healing warmth washes over you. The ghost attacks through the smoke.
HYSTERIA! You furiously burn the sage. It heals your mind, though the ghost still claws your soul!
Sweet smoke fills the dark hall. Sanity returns. The specter strikes through the veil.
HYSTERIA! You gasp for air as the sage burns, dragging you back from the brink of total madness!
You light the last bundle of sage. The scent of life holds back the encroaching nightmare.
HYSTERIA! With shaking hands, you burn the final sage. The heavy fog of insanity lifts just enough.
